scope: Exactly two fair D04-only DEV rows for the existing completion relaxation restricted by necessary inbound energy. No unchanged baseline rerun, extra profiling, new domain, main experiment or holdout.

model.provenance: Existing Shandong DEV physical model retained; no battery/consumption change to induce multiple charging

resources.map_preparation_accounting: Separate wall/CPU/RSS; no free N-squared selected-leg table; selected legs refined on demand

accounting.policy: Carry prior charged use; conservatively precharge 60s for development/native correctness and finite tiny REF checks, then all observed fresh worker CPU including compiler/cold load. Preparation separate. No retries or budget extension.

selection_assessment.rule: Existing D04 domain only; exact prior input digest required. No geographic expansion.

routing_policy.trigger: For a non-origin source, cumulative uncached old-potential A* edge relaxations reach the full graph edge count; build its full forward time tree on the next pair miss that needs it.
routing_policy.construction_accounting: Dynamic query work, included in loaded query limit and native leg/scalar timers; no new persistent cache outside the existing scalar LRU.
routing_policy.ties: Use the exact source distances as a consistent reverse A* potential, retain strict-greater cutoff and the complete equality contour; reconstruct the existing canonical node/edge path and actual length.

correctness_before_dev: Directed landmark inbound admissibility/coverage and singleton parity; static extrema queries without member traversal
Clipped endpoints, exact equality, open endpoints, negative slopes, disconnected unions and charge/service kink
Tiny physical continuation admissibility with repeated stops and service overlap
Independent tiny REF/full K and physical replay; primary/secondary unattainment and schedule shifts
No-seed two-charge search, positive arrival floor and destination reserve distinction
Selected-fastest actual length late rejection, disabled/use_bound=False controls and counters
Unrestricted six-charge depth and strictly greater incumbent pruning; strict boolean API
interpretation: Only two new unprofiled 120s loaded D04 energy N128 rows; 60s target. Compare honest censored work with preserved PR27 rows, without a baseline rerun. No expected route reduction, speedup or exact-completion claim before measurements.

completion_refinement.inbound_length: Existing Region remaining-length lower bound minus its static minimum onward length; directed triangle inequalities, no member scan.
completion_refinement.inbound_requirement: minimum_energy + consumption * inbound_length_lower_bound; after selected routing use the actual selected inbound length in the same relaxation.
completion_refinement.domain: For each affine post-stop piece minimize the existing bound on [max(lo,requirement),hi]. Exclude only lo>hi; retain equality and open-endpoint limits as lower bounds, never incumbents.
completion_refinement.fairness: Same seed, road index, two-slot source reuse, kernels, information, resource guards and refinement for Strong singleton and Scale Region.
completion_refinement.attribution: Pre-route region/action exclusions separately counted from late energy-empty actions after a selected-leg query.
